an6.111:1.5: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an6.111:1.7: Kāmadhātuyā pahānāya nekkhammadhātu bhāvetabbā, vyāpādadhātuyā pahānāya avyāpādadhātu bhāvetabbā, vihiṃsādhātuyā pahāṇāya avihiṃsādhātu bhāvetabbā.
an6.111:1.8: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya ime tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā ti. 1.
